name: Feature request

title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

## The problem

What is difficult or impossible today, and who experiences it (worker / employer / staff / partner)?

## Proposed change

What you'd like to happen. Keep it concrete.

## Which side does it help?

- [ ] Workers
- [ ] Employers
- [ ] Trust & safety / operations
- [ ] Developers / documentation
- [ ] Website visitors / investors

## Does it affect the trust model?

- [ ] Yes — it touches verification, payments, shifts, reputation or disputes
- [ ] No

If yes, describe how the "never claim what the system hasn't confirmed" invariant stays true.

## Alternatives considered

Anything else you thought about, and why the proposed change is better.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues
- [ ] This is not a security vulnerability (see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Innovator123-sudo/kalla-lai/blob/master/SECURITY.md))
- [ ] I have not included any real user data or credentials
